question: A person standing at a distance looks at a building having a height of 1000 metres. The angle between the top of the building and the ground is 30°. At what approximate distance (in metres) is the person standing away from the building.
solution:
**Given:**

Height of building = 1000 m

Angle of elevation = 30°

**Formula used:**

Tan θ = perpendicular/Base = P/B

Tan 30° = 1/√3

Value of √3 = 1.732 

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e0647242a0747a3d09b3f012b8934bbd7c8c850a669a20bc25fbc5e90b5bf68.png] 

Tan 30° = AB/BC

⇒ 1/√3 = 1000/BC

⇒ BC = 1000√3

⇒ BC = 1000 × 1.732 = 1732 m

**∴ The correct answer is 1732 m.**
